newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FARMA SIGNS AGREEMENT WITH GRINDEX.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FARMA SIGNS AGREEMENT WITH GRINDEX.

text.p: Tallinna Farmaatsiatehas said on Friday it has signed a cooperation agreement with the Latvian pharmacy company Grindex.
"Farmaatsiatehas will organize sales of Grindex medicines in Russia and Grindex will help Farmaatsiatehas in developing new products," the company said in a statement.
Grindex, with an estimated turnover of $20 million in 1997, exports 40 percent of its products to the West, 30 percent to the Baltics and 30 percent to Russia.
"The agreement marks the union between two highly developed pharmacy companies in the Baltics," Priit Kivi, the company's cjairman, said in the statement.
